scope: fixed two-node hosted recovery diagnostic; no broader gate

cases.observed: The injected Mihomo probe returned HTTP 504 Timeout. Recovery entered emergency_direct operation 1; _run_pipeline_for_state returned ok=false; the override returned ok=false/outcome=failed and emergency_direct returned action=none/outcome=failed. The test stopped because the API reported provider_recovery_pending instead of emergency_direct.
cases.attribution: Emergency Direct reached a real Core apply attempt, which returned failure. The observer recorded only the outer ok flag; this run does not identify the Core apply stage or error code. A separate refresh_result preflight record is not correlated to this recovery operation and is not attributed as its cause.

cases.observed: The competing public selector call returned ok=false/applied=false. The operation-correlated worker record gives error_code=provider_operation_busy and selected_member_present=true. No Core selection commit was recorded, so the intended selector-wins race and stale-handoff fence assertion did not occur.
cases.attribution: The selector's provider operation was deferred by the existing provider-operation reservation while the test held the provider probe in the in-flight handoff. This run proves the selector did not win; it does not test the later fence. No reservation bypass or source behavior change is justified by this result.
